notes:
- New DESIGN screen (on the menu once a movie is added, and in the Book): pick the style with a live preview of your film's frames, and fix a dark film with Brightness, Contrast and Shadows.
- New style: As filmed, which keeps the video's own picture.
- Page options: paper size, full bleed (panels to the edge of the page), and page numbers outside, inside, centred or off, plain or in a circle, box or cut-out tab, at the height you want.
- Nothing is made until you press Make comic.
